task_description: Translate a user's natural-language instruction into a single JSON tool call. Inputs cover everyday home/office assistant tasks: weather lookups, email composition, web search, timers, calendar events, stock prices, translation, and arithmetic. Outputs must always be valid JSON matching one of the provided tool definitions exactly.

tool_definitions.name: get_weather
tool_definitions.description: Look up the current weather for a city.

tool_definitions.name: send_email
tool_definitions.description: Send an email to one recipient.

tool_definitions.name: search_web
tool_definitions.description: Run a web search and return top results.

tool_definitions.name: set_timer
tool_definitions.description: Set a countdown timer in seconds.

tool_definitions.name: create_calendar_event
tool_definitions.description: Add an event to the calendar.

tool_definitions.name: get_stock_price
tool_definitions.description: Look up the latest stock price.

tool_definitions.name: translate_text
tool_definitions.description: Translate text into a target language.
